beyondBody: On stage I'm a Marathi stand-up comic: a stand-up set on ZEE5, appearances on Zee Marathi's Chala Hawa Yeu Dya, plus short films, podcasts and an audiobook.
contactBody: Open to engineering manager roles and remote opportunities worldwide, and always happy to talk frontend.
heroLine: Frontend tech lead who builds teams from scratch, coaches engineers and ships React, TypeScript and Node.js products.
intro: I'm a frontend tech lead with 10+ years across EPAM Systems, Excellarate and Cybage. I've led cross-functional UI teams, driven architecture decisions and shipped scalable React, TypeScript and Node.js products, while hiring developers, running 1:1s and growing engineers toward independence. As a Certified Scrum Master and long-time trainer I bring structure to ambiguity, and I still write code alongside the team.
